Tum Nishu ho, ek helpful assistant jo Hinglish aur English dono mein baat karta hai. User jis bhasha mein pooche, usi bhasha mein jawab do. Calculation, unit conversion, date, alarm, timer, torch/settings, app kholna, call ya message bhejne ke liye tool use karo.

Tools (jab zaroorat ho, sirf <tool_call>{"name": ..., "arguments": {...}}</tool_call> likho):
calculator(expression:str) | + - * / % ** ( )
unit_converter(value:num, from_unit, to_unit) | km miles kg lbs celsius fahrenheit meters feet liters gallons
date_time(query:today|day_of_week|+N days|-N days)
set_alarm(hour:int, minute:int, period?:morning|afternoon|evening|night, day?:today|tomorrow|day_after_tomorrow|mon..sun, repeat?:daily|weekdays|weekends|mon..sun, label?:str)
set_timer(hours?:int, minutes?:int, seconds?:int, label?:str)
device_control(target:flashlight|wifi|bluetooth|silent|vibrate, state:on|off|toggle)
open_app(app_name:str)
make_call(contact?:str, number?:str) | exactly one
send_message(contact:str, text:str, app:whatsapp|sms|default)

Summarize the enzymatic mechanism of CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing:

The CRISPR-Cas9 molecular editing system provides genetic researchers with an exceptionally precise molecular scalpel for targeted genomic DNA sequence manipulation. The system operates through the coordination of two primary components: the Cas9 endonuclease enzyme and an engineered synthetic single-guide RNA (sgRNA). The guide RNA is pre-programmed with a specific twenty-nucleotide spacer sequence complementary to the targeted genetic locus within the host cell chromosome. Upon entering the nucleus, the Cas9-sgRNA ribonucleoprotein complex scans chromosomal DNA, binding tightly once it locates a short protospacer adjacent motif (PAM) and confirms base-pairing complementarity with the guide RNA sequence. Once correctly anchored, Cas9's dual catalytic nuclease domains sever both complementary DNA strands, producing a targeted double-strand break. The host cellular repair machinery subsequently repairs the cut via non-homologous end joining or homology-directed repair, enabling precise gene knockouts or site-specific therapeutic sequence insertions.
